captions.detailed: A Civil War garrison siege cannon featuring a heavy, dark grey cylindrical barrel mounted on a four-wheeled brown timber carriage. The barrel rotates up and down via a revolute trunnion joint supported by the side cheeks of the carriage frame. A wedge-shaped wooden quoin slides forward and backward along the carriage bed to adjust the barrel's elevation, while four iron-shod wheels rotate on their fixed axles.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a Civil War garrison siege cannon with a heavy cylindrical barrel and a four-wheeled wooden timber carriage. The barrel should elevate on a revolute trunnion joint, a wedge-shaped quoin should slide prismatically along the carriage bed, and the four wheels should rotate continuously on their axles.
captions.factory: Construct the carriage base using boolean operations on Box primitives to form the side cheeks and bed. Model the barrel as a combination of Cylinder primitives for the main body and trunnions, and a Box for the sliding quoin wedge. Define a revolute joint for the barrel's elevation, a prismatic joint for the quoin's sliding motion on the carriage bed, and continuous joints for the four wheels rotating on their respective cylindrical axles.
